purpose: P2a event-stream fixture for the dsh-native Zig adapter: drive the real harness with a scripted provider and interaction, then compare the normalized v4 session log.

sourceArtifacts.reason: No snapshot records /export; the lifecycle and settlement text follow the command source. command/run carries args:"" because recordInput defaults to true.

providerModelConvention.name: fake
providerModelConvention.note: provider/model are literal so request headers stay comparable without tokens; replay.json keeps the P1 packed-stream call format and the runner reduces each call to ChatResponse text/tool calls/usage.

openIssues: The adapter repeats a system/message per step; dsh snapshots show one system message per session. Compaction can therefore select a mid-conversation system node.
The approval fixtures escalate a write call (portable to Windows); the dsh snapshots escalate bash. The gate itself is tool-agnostic.
The approval reason is the call justification, not dsh escalation wording ("escalate sandbox to <mode>: <justification>").
The provider bridge is blocking and returns one text block per call; replay.json is reduced from the P1 packed-stream format.

validation.result: Both build configs pass with 0 leaks; see the P2a record.

scenarioInput.note: Same vocabulary as the P1 fixtures. The runner seeds a fixed empty session (fixture-session) and restores it before the steps, so newSession only writes the workspace files. prompt takes optional approval/questions/noInteraction scripts.
